name: image
yaml:
# WadSpaces host configuration, read by wadd.
# Workspaces here become quadlet units (wad-<id>.container). Wad Creator (the
# kiosk's shell, /usr/bin/wadcreator) edits this file through wadd's API.
version: 1
machine:
  name: wadspaces
daemon:
  bind: 127.0.0.1
  port: 8080
  backend: systemd
  podman_socket: /run/podman/podman.sock
  cdp_url: http://127.0.0.1:9222
  quadlet_dir: /etc/containers/systemd
  # wadd grabs the keyboards: Super+Tab switches, Super+1..9 jump, Super+0 or
  # Super+Space bring back Wad Creator, and the `block` chords never reach
  # the kiosk.
  keys:
    enabled: true
    launcher: [KEY_0, KEY_SPACE]
    block: [alt+f4, ctrl+shift+q, ctrl+alt+backspace]
  ready_timeout_s: 900
  # Images are downloaded from Wad Creator (Download on a wadspace) or on the
  # first switch, never in the background at boot: on a small disk the six
  # images (~20 GB, sharing a 2.8 GB base) do not all fit. "autostart" or
  # "all" download after boot instead, keeping prefetch_min_free_gb free.
  prefetch: none
  prefetch_min_free_gb: 5
launcher:
  # The old Electron Wad Creator, which ran as a window of its own; nothing is
  # installed here now. Never /usr/bin/wadcreator: wadd would take the shell
  # for that window and move it off the screen.
  wadcreator_app: /usr/lib/wadcreator/wadcreator
  allow_navigate: []
# The old in-kiosk web copy of Wad Creator (dev only now).
wadcreator:
  enabled: false
# The online Wad Creator reaches this machine through Firestore once it is
# linked (Wad Creator links it when you first sign in). Idle until then. The
# project comes from /usr/lib/wadspaces/cloud.yaml, which updates with the
# image; a cloud: section here can add settings (e.g. heartbeat_s).
workspaces:
  - id: writing
    name: Writing
    image: ghcr.io/hunggod/wadspaces-cosmic-bodybuilding:latest
    # lean image: its desktop is a window on this screen, not a stream
    display: host
    hotkey: 1
    icon: /usr/share/wadspaces/icons/writing.png
    env:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: Pacific/Fiji
      GIT_USER_NAME: HungGod
      GIT_USER_EMAIL: throwupcow@gmail.com
    secrets: [github_token]
    volumes: [wad-writing-obsidian:/config/.config/obsidian:z]
    devices: [/dev/dri]
    shm_size: 1g
  - id: iq-dev
    name: IntelligenceQuest Dev
    image: ghcr.io/hunggod/wadspaces-iq-dev:latest
    # lean image: its desktop is a window on this screen, not a stream
    display: host
    hotkey: 2
    icon: /usr/share/wadspaces/icons/iq-dev.png
    env:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: Pacific/Fiji
      GIT_USER_NAME: HungGod
      GIT_USER_EMAIL: throwupcow@gmail.com
    secrets: [github_token]
    volumes: [wad-iq-dev-config:/config:z]
    devices: [/dev/dri]
    shm_size: 1g
  - id: wad-c
    name: Wad Creator Dev
    image: ghcr.io/hunggod/wadspaces-wad-c:latest
    # lean image: its desktop is a window on this screen, not a stream
    display: host
    hotkey: 3
    icon: /usr/share/wadspaces/icons/wad-c.png
    env:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: Pacific/Fiji
      GIT_USER_NAME: HungGod
      GIT_USER_EMAIL: throwupcow@gmail.com
    secrets: [github_token]
    volumes: [wad-wad-c-config:/config:z]
    devices: [/dev/dri]
    shm_size: 1g
  - id: kale-b
    name: Kale Browser
    image: ghcr.io/hunggod/wadspaces-kale-b:latest
    # lean image: its desktop is a window on this screen, not a stream
    display: host
    hotkey: 4

    env:

name: dev
yaml:
# Dev config: drives the containers made by podman-compose in ../containers/*
# (container_name wad-<id>) over the user podman socket. Run dev/run-dev.sh.
version: 1
machine:
  name: dev
daemon:
  backend: podman
  keys:
    enabled: true
launcher:
  wadcreator_url: http://localhost:8081/
wadcreator:
  enabled: true
  dist: ../../apps/wadcreator/dist
workspaces:
  - id: writing
    name: Writing
    image: localhost/wadspaces-cosmic-bodybuilding:latest
    port: 3100
